podcast.body: Jerry Lee Lewis considered recording this song by Big Joe Turner when seeking material for his second single. "He'd play old Jean Orchery songs and Big Joe Turner's honey hush."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 59: "Whole Lotta Shakin' Goin' On" by Jerry Lee Lewis

podcast.body: This song was originally written and recorded by Big Joe Turner three years before the Rock and Roll Trio's 1956 cover version. The original is noted for leaning heavily on the misogyny that characterized much of Turner's work. "The A-side, Horie Hosh, was eventually written and recorded by Big Joe Turner three years earlier."
